explanation: Generated 3 input files for eta electroproduction (ep → e'pη) with 25 kinematic points. Fixed W=1.6 GeV, Q²=1.0 GeV², cos(θ*)=0. Phi* spans 0–345° in 25 evenly-spaced steps (14.375° intervals). Used standard CLAS12 parameters: EtaMAID model (3), bmom=6.53 GeV, proton detection (ivec=1), full O(α) radiative corrections, vcut=0.166 GeV². Chunked into 3 files due to Fortran reader limit of 10 points per file. W=1.6 GeV is well above eta threshold (≈1.485 GeV), all points are physically valid.
